body:
alex: Quick heads-up — ran focused benchmark of flash-attn-v3 + KV-prefetch heuristic on L40s. Seq sweep 64->4096, bsz 1->16. Observed 15-25% latency regression and ~12% token-cost increase at seq 512-1024 for bsz >= 8. cc @marta @suyash :eyes:

marta: Do you have raw numbers + kernel-selection breakdown? Could be selector flip to a slower fused/paged path.

alex: Summary (median p95 ms, tokens/s, kernel pick %):
L40s | seq=256 bsz=8  p95=42ms  tokens/s=120k  pick: flash-v3=76%, fused=18%, paged=6%
L40s | seq=512 bsz=8  p95=88ms  tokens/s=95k   pick: flash-v3=42%, fused=42%, paged=16%
L40s | seq=1024 bsz=8 p95=160ms  tokens/s=70k   pick: flash-v3=18%, fused=62%, paged=20%
A100 | seq=1024 bsz=8 p95=140ms tokens/s=72k   pick: flash-v3=78%, fused=18%, paged=4%
H100 | seq=1024 bsz=8 p95=135ms tokens/s=74k   pick: flash-v3=80%, fused=15%, paged=5%

alex: Regression correlated with increased fused picks on L40s for mid->long seqs.

suyash: A100/H100 stable, likely L40s fused path slower. Any recent prefetch changes?

alex: Yes — this week lowered prefetch cap 4MB->1MB to curb mem spikes for many small requests. That changed memory residency and nudged selector; more fused/paged fallbacks.

ben: Can you upload kernel decision trace for seq=512 bsz=8? Need per-layer picks + runtime estimate.

alex: Trace uploaded: https://internal.redwood/perf/2401234567/trace_seq512_b8.log. Excerpt:
layer 8: prefetched_kv=512KB selector_score: flash=0.46 fused=0.52 paged=0.02 -> fused
layer 9: prefetched_kv=480KB selector_score: flash=0.44 fused=0.54 paged=0.02 -> fused

ciara-bot: Perf-test-run finished: run=2401234567, status=regression, delta_p95=+18%, alert=oncall-eng-infra

marta: Mitigations: (1) revert prefetch cap until tuning for L40s, (2) make selector GPU-aware with per-device profiles and bias to flash on L40s when flash faster.

suyash: Prefer (2) long-term. Short-term do (1) + canary that disables prefetch on L40s for bsz>=8 & seq>=512. Also add unit-cost metric (tokens/cent) to compare kernels during warm-up.

alex: Draft canary config (console flags):
runtime.kernel_selector: device_overrides: L40S: { disable_prefetch_for: { min_seq:512, min_batch:8 } } perf_bias: { prefer_kernel: { L40S: flash-v3:+0.08 } }
Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/8789 — includes tests + perf notes. Rolling canary to 10% fleet in 1h.

ben: Add sampling profiler hook to export kernel latency histograms to console for affected routes.

marta: Also file Optimize suggestion to evaluate quant/pack strategies — fused might benefit from different quant boundaries on L40s.

alex: Will run heatmap (seq x bsz) for p95 and unit-cost post-canary and post results will be posted in #eng-runtime. Thanks :thumbsup:
